title: Game Called on Account of Bees
content: Coined in 1986 by Thomas Roderick for a new journal and discipline (Kuska 1998, Yadav 2007), the word “genomics” is so thoroughly integrated into popular culture that it’s difficult to remember a time before it existed. Since its coinage, the “-omics” ending, effectively meaning “a collective set in its entirety” within the field of molecular biology, has been tacked on to dozens of stem words; there’s even a Wikipedia entry for “-omics” by itself (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Omics).
